name: autotube
description: AutoTube - AI-assisted YouTube content automation dashboard

scripts.start: AUTOTUBE_COBALT_API_URL=https://cobalt-api.hyper.lol AUTOTUBE_DISABLE_LTX=1 sh -c 'node .pot-provider/server/build/main.js --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4416 >/tmp/bgutil-pot.log 2>&1 & POT_PID=$!; READY=0; for i in $(seq 1 45); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4416/ping >/dev/null 2>&1; then READY=1; break; fi; if ! kill -0 $POT_PID 2>/dev/null; then cat /tmp/bgutil-pot.log >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; if [ $READY -ne 1 ]; then cat /tmp/bgutil-pot.log >&2; exit 1; fi; echo POT_PROVIDER_READY; exec node --expose-gc -r ./disable-startup-selftest-preload.js -r ./youtube-download-fallback-preload.js -r ./youtube-routes-preload.js -r ./render-stability-preload.js -r ./url-to-mp4-preload.js -r ./gemini-image-fix-preload.js -r ./disable-ltx-preload.js -r ./render-memory-preload.js server.js'
